tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Adobe Commerce Migration & Enterprise Integrations
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience migrating, building and integrating complex e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud/Hybris for global clients including Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, microservices, and orchestrating robust third-party integrations with PIM, ERP, and OMS platforms. Proven track record in techno-functional delivery, requirements analysis, and optimizing platform performance across international agile environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce (US)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining Codeandtheory for complex enterprise e-commerce platform migrations and architectures. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on expertise building and integrating enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud/Hybris at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer deep technical and architectural depth across large-scale ecosystems.

bullets.label: Platform Migrations & Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized complex data pipelines and architecture workflows connecting PIM, ERP, MDM, and e-commerce storefronts across global channels.

bullets.label: Extension & API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed robust OCC REST Web Services and custom headless APIs, alongside advanced extension development using Java, Spring, and platform best practices.

bullets.label: Third-Party & Enterprise Ecosystems
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved intricate integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, OMS, and Profisee platforms, ensuring high system stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical execution by translating stakeholder needs into scalable solution designs, user stories, and robust backend implementations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving my notice period with a final working day on 15 December 2026, and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise e-commerce and integration experience aligns with Codeandtheory.

tailoring.why_company: I want to join Codeandtheory to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce engineering experience—specifically in complex platform integrations, PIM/ERP/OMS connectivity, and scalable extension development—to architect high-performance solutions for global brands.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, API integration, and architectural delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell to drive impactful platform migrations and extensions at Codeandtheory.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience specializing in complex platform integrations, API architecture, and backend development (Rockwell Automation, Shell), I am very interested in the Adobe Multi-Solution Architect role at Codeandtheory. My CV and application are ready for review.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce (US) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce role at Codeandtheory. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms, complex API integrations, and PIM/ERP data pipelines at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in system architecture and extension development.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026, and available from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
